exposure: Maternal serum TSH levels (preconception and at 12 weeks of gestation)
cohort: 158 IVF-conceived pregnant women and 117 age-matched non-pregnant controls (≤39 years, BMI 18.5-38 kg/m2)
finding: Maternal TSH levels within the normal range (0.4-4.0 μIU/mL) at preconception and 12 weeks of gestation did not predict IVF success or adverse pregnancy outcomes in IVF pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section risk was higher when TSH was >2.5 μIU/mL.
